A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LoTUS and RF-JSD work. Their main text, supplementary Sections 7–17, equations, tables and figures are available and support reliable comparison through text extraction and rendered-page inspection.

before.justification: v1 reports original unlearning experiments with ViT and ResNet18, including ImageNet1k evaluation, class-unlearning results, metric correlations and supplementary ablations.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results in the main text and supplementary material, including Tables 1–4 and 6–10.

M1.justification: The teacher–student procedure, Gumbel noise, dynamic temperature and forget/retain loss remain unchanged. The class-unlearning adaptation in Section 14 and Equation 14 was already present in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions use CIFAR-10/100, TinyImageNet, MUFAC, ImageNet1k and CIFAKE synthetic calibration data. Instance-wise unlearning, class unlearning, synthetic unseen data and restricted-data scenarios are all retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments, including the different subsets in Tables 3 and 8. The same eight baselines remain: Finetuning, NegGrad+, Random Labeling, Bad Teacher, SCRUB, SSD, UNSIR and SalUn.

E3.justification: Sections 4–5 retain the same splits, metrics, preprocessing and experimental settings, including 10%/50% forget settings, 30% retain-data use, three/ten unlearning epochs for ViT/ResNet18 and the ImageNet1k sample allocations.

E4.justification: The synthetic-unseen evaluation, Gumbel-noise ablation, MUFAC failure analysis, class activation maps and entropy-based privacy analysis are unchanged. The added Section 14 summary introduces no new analysis or evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions specify three evaluation seeds and retain the same mean/standard-deviation reporting. Table 7's Pearson correlations and p-value reporting are also unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched main-text and supplementary tables and plots retain their numerical values and findings. For example, Table 4 still reports LoTUS RF-JSD×10^4 of 1.11±0.01, and Table 7 retains mean PCC 0.92±0.04.

T1.justification: The information-theoretic proposition, assumptions, entropy/Fano derivation, RF-JSD definition, complexity analysis and class-unlearning equations are unchanged. Edits around the mathematics are stylistic.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about LoTUS, RF-JSD, effectiveness, efficiency and applicability under large-scale and restricted-data conditions.

C2.justification: Interpretations of distributional similarity, MUFAC difficulty, accuracy versus JSD and privacy remain unchanged, as does the limitation of less extensive class-unlearning evaluation. Section 14's added Table 9 summary restates applicability and performance assertions already made in v1.

D1.justification: The hyperparameters, software, hardware, MUFAC cleaning instructions and reported code/notebook availability are unchanged. Section 8's wording edits disclose no additional reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2, the reference list and positioning relative to existing unlearning methods and ZRF remain unchanged. The added CVPR acceptance notice is publication metadata.

P1.justification: v3 lightly edits the abstract, introduction and supplementary prose, corrects Section 5's table references, and adds a short class-unlearning summary. It also expands Gavves's given name and adds a CVPR 2025 acceptance notice; section organization remains intact.

P2.justification: There is limited first-page and supplementary column reflow, notably keeping Section 17 together in the right column on PDF page 15. Table 10's caption changes 'experimental settings' to 'benchmarks'; figure and table designs remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves clarity and evidence traceability. In particular, Section 5 now correctly directs the synthetic-data discussion to Table 2 instead of Table 9, which contains class-unlearning results. Prose refinements and small layout improvements aid reading, while the scientific evidence, reproducibility information and limitations remain unchanged.
